title: audit-export-pool
blurb: Expected export failures leak pooled connections and leave transactions dirty until every request times out.
brief:
Audit exports work after a deploy, then fail once several denied or cancelled requests have passed through the service. Pool telemetry shows all four connections checked out, and the captured session snapshot includes unfinished transactions.

Start with `diagnostics/`, then inspect the ownership boundaries in `audit_export/service.py`. The pool is a deterministic stand-in for a production driver and is not the defect.

**Your job:** make every acquired connection and transaction finish cleanly on success and on every failure path. Do not increase capacity or timeouts.
